content.comment_body: Hello. I finally tried the new [product_name] and [product_name]. This is my first experimental project, but I have an issue: why do analog values not show the decimal point? Regards, [user_name]
This is a bug. Decimal points are not available, and the values are left-aligned, similar to the early versions of [product_name]. [company_name] seems to repeat old mistakes. It's frustrating.

Hello. This is poorly implemented and quite disappointing. Many users will encounter this. I find it embarrassing when things from [company_name] work this way, especially after they promised improvements for two years, yet such basic issues remain. [user_name]

Hi, [product_name] does not support floating point values. In a [product_name] program, you can select to display a decimal point in a text message, but as mentioned earlier, in the [product_name], this limitation is not a bug, it's simply the way it works. The only floating point support is converting between floating and integer values, for example, when receiving values from Modbus devices. But overall, [product_name] lacks real floating point support. Hope this clarifies things.

[user_name], For me, that's not only a limitation - it's a bug. If it's possible to set decimal places in the web server's text messages, then it should work on custom user pages too. The left-justified analog values shown on user-specific web pages are, from my perspective, also a bug.

Hello. If I can't show a decimal point on the [product_name] operator devices or directly on its display, I give up! It's embarrassing! It should be easy to set the decimal point position on the [product_name] display or TDE! Otherwise, you get confusing data like 235C instead of 23.5C. Why does the web server work like this?

Hi, What you want is different from our previous discussion. On [product_name] display, TDE, and TDE web server you can show decimal places by opening the FB's properties and selecting the number of decimal places. Note: Not every FB allows selecting decimal places. The chosen decimal places will be shown on: + [product_name] Display + TDE + TDE-based Web Server But custom web servers do not show these decimal places. For example, FB B004 supports decimal places, but B001 does not. Hope this helps.
Dear [user_name], I agree, it would be a useful feature.

Hello. I see there is confusion. I can manage the decimal point in the [product_name] editor for the user-configurable web server, but the function is missing there. I’m referring to a fixed decimal point, like in the main [product_name] displays. How do you expect users to work without this option? [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are frustrated by the fact that analog values cannot be displayed with decimals in custom web pages made with the [product_name] editor. They see this as a critical bug or missing feature, since other [product_name] interfaces such as the TDE and operator displays do allow decimal formatting. The lack of decimal support affects readability and proper display of measurements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] editor to allow formatting analog values with decimal points on custom web pages, matching the features offered by built-in displays and TDE modules. They want to reliably show accurate values like '23.5°C' rather than '235°C' for more intuitive data presentation.
